name: Direct Play Guard
overview: Disables Jellyfin transcoding and guides users toward Direct Play compatible apps.
description: Jellyfin 12 plugin that disables video and audio transcoding, optionally disables remuxing for strict Direct Play, restores original user permissions when disabled, and shows a custom unsupported-client message in Jellyfin Web.

versions.changelog: Automated Direct Play Guard build from 34b7798.
Automated Direct Play Guard build from 3047d27.
Fix Jellyfin 12 browser compatibility errors so MEDIA_NOT_SUPPORTED dialogs are replaced with the configured Direct Play Guard guidance. Keeps the NoCompatibleStream API hook as a fallback.
